name: Plasticology, LLC
old_description: PLASTICOLOGY, located in northwestern Iowa, specializes in short to long run injection and blow molding production plastic of components and related services. Services include design assistance, 3D prototypes, mold design/making, secondary operations and inventory management (JIT/Dock to Stock/Min-Max).
about:
Plasticology, LLC, a privately held limited liability company, operates from Hawarden, Iowa, in the northwestern part of the state. The company was established in 2007 as a custom injection and blow molding provider.

It specializes in short to long production runs of plastic components, offering injection molding, blow molding, design assistance, 3D prototyping, mold design and making, secondary operations, and inventory management programs such as just-in-time, dock-to-stock, and min-max. The 34,000-square-foot environmentally controlled facility includes docks, silos, overhead cranes, and modern equipment to support complete custom services from design through final qualified thermoplastic products. The company also provides tooling services and production support ranging from prototyping to mass manufacturing.

Plasticology produces parts in materials including LDPE, rigid PVC, PETG, ABS and high-impact grades, acrylic, and polypropylene, serving original equipment manufacturers and other customers requiring custom thermoplastic components.

The company states its focus is on employees, customers, quality, service, competitive pricing, efficiency and cost-reduction improvements, and community. Its mission emphasizes developing long-term relationships to help customers maintain and improve their performance through coordinated teamwork. Plasticology maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification as part of its quality commitment.
